name: king-of-barbecue
description: King of Barbecue — restaurant commerce & operations platform (Phase 1 MVP)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @kob/core && npm run build -w @kob/api && npm run build -w @kob/worker && npm run build -w @kob/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @kob/api" "npm run dev -w @kob/worker" "npm run dev -w @kob/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @kob/core && npm run test -w @kob/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @kob/core && npm run typecheck -w @kob/api && npm run typecheck -w @kob/worker && npm run typecheck -w @kob/web
